summary: Extend verified repository placement and compose multi-repo delivery bundles (#383)

architecture.decision: Keep DeliveryPlacementV1 and CompiledWorkPlanV1 intact for existing v1 compatibility, introduce TrustedTargetPolicyV1, DeliveryPlacementV2, TicketCandidateV2, CompiledWorkPlanV2, and DeliveryPlanBundleV1 with anti-owner-aliasing checks and <=12 single-repo subplans, wire preflight, v1->v2 ticket-preserving migration, dry-run, idempotent replay/resume, and real cross-repo blocked_by/blocks ticket wiring while keeping authority=none and execution=inert.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit on main; v1 delivery-plan state files remain unchanged and compatible.

nonGoals: Relaxing the <=12 candidate or single-repository invariant of CompiledWorkPlanV1
Granting execution authority, leases, or runner dispatch from delivery-plan schema validity
Implicit owner aliasing between placement.home and foreign repositories
delivery.outcome: Planfile validates and materializes versioned multi-repo delivery bundles from bounded native subplans over trusted targets with real cross-repo DAG ticket edges and resumable replay.

validation.evidence: Verified uritime/autodo and paxlet-com/heyasa v2 acceptance with exact base SHAs, v1 refusal (delivery_plan_v1_placement_unsupported), and pre-write rejection of untrusted targets, owner aliases, and runtime owners.
Verified all existing v1 delivery-plan tests pass unchanged and explicit migrate_delivery_plan_v1_to_v2 preserves exact ticket IDs, checkpoints, and repository conflict checks.
Verified 12 vs 13 candidate matrix (v1 rejects 13; bundle splits 13 into 12+1) and 36-proposal campaign (AUTO10+LLM10+HEY10+PLAN6) passes POST /delivery-plans/preflight as 4 bounded subplans.

Verified dry-run zero writes, idempotent replay, crash recovery after missing subplan/bundle state preserving exact ticket IDs, and pre-write rejection of conflicting hashes, base SHAs, or external deps.

commands: pytest -q tests/test_delivery_plan.py tests/test_delivery_plan_multi_repo_bundle.py tests/test_autonomy_version_and_payloads.py tests/test_release_availability.py tests/test_ci_readiness.py tests/test_comparative_findings.py tests/test_ticket_api_events.py tests/test_cli_startup.py
validation.evidence: Verified executor=None and authority=none/execution=inert on all foreign-namespace tickets with real cross-repo blocked_by/blocks links; 135 passed across all 8 test suites and ruff check passed.
